paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter: Dark E-Field Radio Pilot Experiment
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (dimensionless); plot y-axis is log10(epsilon), values emitted as epsilon = 10^(plotted value)
notes: Pilot run of the Dark E-field Radio experiment (UC Davis). Measured 5-sigma limits: epsilon ~1e-12 over 50-300 MHz (broadband pilot, ~3.8 hr real-time data, Fig. 9), and a stronger spot limit epsilon < 6.4e-13 near 70.5 MHz from a 1e6 s narrow-band integration. The 50-300 MHz band corresponds to m_gamma' = 2.07e-7 to 1.24e-6 eV; I encoded the broadband limit as a flat two-point line at 1e-12 (abstract-quoted level; actual curve in Fig. 9 varies roughly log10(eps) -12 to -10.5 but exact digitized values unavailable). Phase-I and Phase-II curves (Figs. 12-13) are PROJECTIONS and are NOT included in data_points. Stated confidence is 5-sigma, stronger than the 0.95 recorded here. Local DM density: paper quotes 380+/-180 TeV/m^3 (~0.38 GeV/cm^3).
